items.title: John Bunch interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: we played a lot of dances, in Med Flory’s band. ... I wanted to play with his band

ctx.x: Tell us about that. Tell us about the program that was going on at that time.

Well you know they had a great music school, they still have you know. But at that time they frowned on jazz. Jazz was sort of a dirty word in those days, in 1946 or ‘5, whenever it was. And not only that but I wasn’t a very good, legitimate musician. I couldn’t read music very well and didn’t have any classical training, so I wasn’t accepted in music school so I was very disappointed. But I went there anyhow because there was a very good jazz band there that we made, we played a lot of dances, in Med Flory’s…
figured that’s as close as I can get to music. And meanwhile I took piano lessons while I was there on the side you know, to learn to play classical music and read music better.
